text:
Noelle Park: Hi everyone! Super excited to join Redwood Inference today as a Developer Tools Engineer. I'm Noelle (she/her), live in Berkeley and bike to the ferry. Slightly obsessive about vintage mechanical keyboards and fermented hot sauces. Looking forward to meeting folks in person and learning the stack.
Ethan Ward: Welcome Noelle!! :tada: Keyboard nerds unite. We actually have a small keyboard drawer in the lounge  and a monthly "mod & meet" where folks bring keycaps and lube.
Priya Rao: Hi Noelle, welcome! We do a casual after-work karaoke on the last Thursday of each month if you're up for it  low pressure, high enthusiasm. Also, the bike group rolls out on Fridays at 8:15am from the Ferry Plaza if you ever want company.
facilities-bot: Welcome @Noelle Park! Your welcome kit is scheduled for delivery. Please confirm hoodie size and any dietary or allergy notes: https://redwood.company/welcome (automated)
Noelle Park: Sent hoodie size L and noted: dairy-intolerant (lactose). Happy to bring dairy-free brownies for the welcome meet. Also huge yes to the keyboard meet  my Model M is lonely.
Ethan Ward: Dairy-free brownies = saint. I'll add you to the "Hardware Hangouts" calendar and ping you about the next mod & meet. Also, there's a tiny shelf of soldering supplies in the maker corner if you ever want to do a switch swap.
Priya Rao: Karaoke + bikes + keyboards  this onboarding is already peak. Sent a 20-min intro sync invite for Wed 2pm to run through repos, CI access, and quick local dev demo.
welcome-bot: Welcome @Noelle Park! You've been added to #new-hires and granted access to the "DevTools Onboarding" doc: https://redwood.company/onboarding/devtools (automated)
Noelle Park: Thanks all! Quick note: I'm also trying to find the best dairy-free oat milk latte in SF  any recs?
Ethan Ward: Try Blue Harbor on 4th  their oat latte is legendary. Also, bring a picture of your keyboard to the intro chat for immediate friendship credits.
facilities-bot: Logged: hoodie L, dietary note (lactose intolerance). Welcome kit ETA: Wed.
Noelle Park: Perfect, see you soon  and I will absolutely bring keyboard pics and brownies.
